text:
sam: Quick heads-up — after flipping FP8 kernels for r12 models in staging, P95 token latency under burst traffic jumped from ~65ms to ~140ms. CPU spin and kernel-switch churn in the trace. attaching perf link: https://perf.redwood/trace/7762 :eyes:
elaine: ugh. do we have a repro? is it correlated with calibration step?
sam: Yes — observed only when using per-layer calibration + mixed FP8/INT8 fallback. If I force per-tensor calibration the spike goes away.
patrick: Can you paste the hot-stack?
sam: Sure, trimmed trace:
```
# hot kernels
fp8_gemm_kernel(layer=4)  -> 30%
int8_gemm_kernel(layer=5)  -> 28%
kernel_selector(recompile) -> 15%
kv_cache_read            -> 10%
other                    -> 17%
```
patrick: Looks like selector keeps bouncing between fp8 and int8 GEMMs — kernel cache thrash. That would explain spike on small bursts.
miles: Also see increased KV cache misses when kernel compiles happen during requests — allocation stalls. Might be eviction policy interacting badly.
anya: Do we have telemetry for compile latency and JIT churn? perf-bot: compile_time histogram: 95p=72ms, 99p=210ms during the window. KV cache miss rate +3.2%.
elaine: If calibration changes quant params per-layer, kernel dispatcher may think a different kernel is optimal -> recompile. We should avoid runtime recompiles during serving.
patrick: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: pin kernel variants for a model version until a maintenance window. Also add a cooldown on kernel reselect to avoid thrash.
sam: We should also expose SDK knobs so users can control behavior: e.g. quant.preset, quant.calibration_mode, quant.fallback_policy, runtime.kernel_cooldown_ms, runtime.batching.max_batch_tokens, runtime.kv.cache_eviction="lru|pin-hot".
anya: Proposal sketch for SDK/REST config (for docs):
```
quant.preset = "performance|balanced|safety"
quant.calibration = "per_tensor|per_layer|none"
quant.fp8_fallback = "allow|fallback-to-int8|fallback-to-4bit"
runtime.kernel_cooldown_ms = 250
runtime.batching.max_batch_tokens = 4096
runtime.kv.prefix_caching = true
quality_guard = { "golden_prompts": [...], "alert_on_wer_increase": 0.03 }
```
elaine: Love the preset idea. Defaults: performance -> auto-pick fastest kernel, balanced -> avoid mixing kernel types on-the-fly, safety -> prefer higher-precision fallback and enable quality guards.
miles: We should add a safety rail that prevents silent quality regressions: automatic compare against small evaluation set after calibration and before serving. If quality delta > threshold, block deployment.
patrick: For runtime implementation: 1) make kernel selection idempotent per model version + quant config, 2) add kernel cooldown (do not reselect for X ms), 3) precompile pinned kernels at rollout time where possible. This should cut compile churn.
sam: Also changed KV cache behavior: pause eviction while compiling to avoid eviction thrash. We'll need to throttle background compiles.
anya: For docs: show examples and warn: "If you use per-layer calibration you may see additional JIT/compile cost — prefer per-tensor for low-latency use-cases or use 'balanced' preset."
patrick: Action items:
- @sam: open infra PR to add kernel_cooldown and precompile hook (link to draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/234)
- @elaine: add SDK param schema + presets to docs (writeups + code samples)
- @miles: add telemetry for compile_time, kernel_switch_count, kv_miss_during_compile
- @anya: add eval gate for calibration artifacts and a docs page with recommended presets and trade-offs
sam: I'll also add an example SDK snippet for users to opt out of auto-calibration in the short term:
```python
# python sdk example
client.create_deployment(
  model="r12-mix",
  quant={
    "preset": "balanced",
    "calibration": "per_tensor",
    "fp8_fallback": "fallback-to-int8"
  },
  runtime={"kernel_cooldown_ms": 300}
)
```
elaine: Nice. keep it in the "quantization knobs" doc with a clear table: param, allowed values, behavior, recommended use-case, safety note.
patrick: We should ship defaults that are conservative to avoid regressions for most users: preset=balanced, calibration=per_tensor, fp8_fallback=fallback-to-int8.
sam: Agreed. I'll prioritize the infra PR and leave a note on the rollout checklist: do not enable per-layer calibration by default for hosted until precompile + eval gate is in place.
dev-bot: deploy check: infra PR 234 created by sam, label: perf-investigation, reviewers: patrick, miles.
anya: I'll draft the docs and a short runbook entry for oncall: how to detect kernel thrash and rollback knobs.
miles: One more thought — consider a lightweight compile-ahead step during model upload that runs a profiling pass with a synthetic prompt distribution so kernels are warmed before traffic. Should cut P95 spikes.
patrick: Good idea. Add to backlog as optimization item.
sam: Thanks team. I'll post follow-ups in the PR and ping when I've got telemetry attached. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: monitoring alert cleared for stage after kernel_cooldown test. P95 back to ~68ms.
